{{Top}}
[[File:AnakinScuba-WotD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] wearing a suit and rebreather helmet for underwater environments]]
'''Rebreathers''' were an upgrade of the standard [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] that was popular in the years during and after the [[Jedi Civil War]]. They were equipment, usually facemasks, that let a member of a species breathe in an atmosphere not suited to their physiology. A rebreather regulated its wearer's oxygen supply; however, the mask had the drawback of being ill-suited for use by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].

[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] and [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] contained rebreathers. [[A99 aquata breather/Legends|A99 aquata breathers]] were one type of rebreather. [[Bacta tank/Legends|Bacta tanks]] used another type of rebreather known as a breather line.
